profile.summary: Current Lead Analyst at Cigna, working as a Software Engineer.

positions.title: Software Engineer Lead Analyst
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · Software Project Management · Software Architecture · Web Application Development · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Fraud Specialist I
positions.description:
- Using effective verbal and written communication to document customer account activities thoroughly and concisely  
- Escalating any potential issues related to suspicious activity or system issues to management  
- Approaching escalated problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome  
- Making appropriate decisions on behalf of the customer quickly and effectively  
- Effectively prioritize work to ensure efficiency while analyzing accounts for suspicious activity  
- Review and respond to cardholder inquiries and provide the appropriate solution

positions.title: Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist
positions.description: Talent Solvers is a modern recruiting company that blends cutting-edge technology with deep industry knowledge and experience with a passion for elevating human potential. Our approach to recruiting is rooted in understanding the people behind the resumes. We leverage our own proprietary technology to meticulously hunt for the few people that, in both skills and values, directly align with your hiring goals.

positions.title: Mobile Application Development Instructor
positions.description:
- Introduced computer programming using block based programming language for android 
- Taught fundamental concepts, including logic, functions, data structures and program design 
- Assisted students with designing and programming a functional mobile app that addresses a social justice issue
- Held office hours to assist students

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted Professor in answering student questions and managing zoom breakout rooms 
- Lead office hours class of 9 students to assist with Python questions without Professor present
- Building and utilizing a LEGO Robot Kit to demonstrate robotics with Python along side students

positions.title: Mobile Retail Expert
positions.description:
- Utilize the Expert app to manage your personal schedule and market coverage
- Provided assistance to customers with data transfers, device setup, software updates, and troubleshooting errors
- Identified customer wants/needs, Described the potential, and Offered personalized solutions 
- Provided feedback and insights about the Expert experience to Captains
- Shared best practices to help drive continual improvement in the market
- Solved challenges in the market
- Promoted a Collaborative Feedback culture in line with the Enjoy Values, Qualities, and Skills Managed inventory (Fleet vehicles, Magic Cases, product, etc.)

positions.title: AI Intern
positions.description:
- Used Python to develop an AI program that predicts potential adverse events given combinations of pharmaceuticals
- Increased my knowledge of Python and Machine Learning
- Collaborated with team to create code and debug errors
- Collaborated with team to create presentation for stakeholder meetings
- Lead side project that used Python to develop a database of Drug Names utilizing ChEMBL API

positions.title: Copy Center Manager
positions.description:
- Lead Graphic Designer
- Inventory/ Budget management
- Design/Update promotional materials for mass distribution
- Generated price quotes for orders based on client order specifications
- Lead department team members including PT and Temporary employees
- Greet/assist customers with inquiries and purchases utilizing cash register to process payments and refunds and resolve escalated customer issues
- Created/maintained a Hassle-free customer service culture, focused on solutions-based selling and exceptional customer experience
- Verified cashier daily balancing of cash drawers for accuracy while ensuring safe cash handling policies and procedures are followed including cash, checks, and credit/debit cards Conducted training for new hires and temporary employees
- Received/verified orders and completed store reports
- Key-holder responsible for opening and/or closing the store
